articles.title: Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Citigroup to Report Earnings. What to Watch.
articles.mainIdea: Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Citigroup to Report Earnings. What to Watch.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Citigroup to Report Earnings. What to Watch.. Bank of America, Citigroup, and Wells Fargo are due to quarterly earnings on Wednesday, one day after JPMorgan Chase posted results that sent its shares tumbling. Analysts expect the three banks’ fourth-quarter earnings per share to have risen from a year earlier, according to estimates compiled by FactSet. Investors will look for executives’ outlooks on President Donald Trump’s proposed limit of 10% on credit card interest rates, consumer health, and dealmaking. Related tickers mentioned: BAC, C, WFC.

articles.title: Trump's credit card cap could make most of industry 'unprofitable'
articles.mainIdea: Trump's credit card cap could make most of industry 'unprofitable'
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Trump's credit card cap could make most of industry 'unprofitable'. JPMorgan Chase (JPM) reached a deal earlier this month to take over Goldman Sachs' (GS) Apple Card (AAPL) account; the costs related to this transfer weighed on the former's earnings figures for the fourth quarter. Additionally, President Trump suggested a 10% cap on credit card fees earlier this week. HSBC Head of US Financials Research Saul Martinez reacts to headlines of the Apple Card impacts and what Trump's policy proposal could mean for the financial sector and credit lenders. Also watch Saul Martinez discuss JPMorgan's latest earnings release. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts. Related tickers mentioned: AAPL, AXP, BAC, C, COF, COF-PK, COF-PL, COF-PN, JPM, MA, SYF-PB, WFC, XLF.
